subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt pmos_bias_generation_network iref_snk vdd
M1 iref_snk iref_snk vdd vdd pmos l=l_cs_p w=w_cs_p*1 m=1 nf=1
.ends pmos_bias_generation_network
subcircuits.role_hint: Diode-connected PMOS bias generation network establishing the iref_snk PMOS current-source gate bias used by the error amplifier and driver current sources.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt ldo_error_amplifier_input_stage gnd iref_snk vdd vin fb net7
M4 net7 vin net5 vdd pmos l=l_eai_p w=w_eai_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M3 net6 fb net5 vdd pmos l=l_eai_p w=w_eai_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M2 net5 iref_snk vdd vdd pmos l=l_cs_p w=w_cs_p*1 m=1 nf=1
M8 net6 net6 gnd gnd nmos l=l_eal_n w=w_eal_n*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M7 net7 net6 gnd gnd nmos l=l_eal_n w=w_eal_n*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
.ends ldo_error_amplifier_input_stage
subcircuits.role_hint: PMOS differential error-amplifier input stage comparing reference input vin against feedback fb, with NMOS current-mirror active load producing the first high-gain node net7.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt ldo_pmos_gate_driver_stage gnd iref_snk vdd net7 net2
M6 gnd net7 net2 vdd pmos l=l_eab_p w=w_eab_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M5 net2 iref_snk vdd vdd pmos l=l_cs_p w=w_cs_p*1 m=1 nf=1
.ends ldo_pmos_gate_driver_stage
subcircuits.role_hint: Second-stage PMOS driver converting the error-amplifier output net7 into the pass-device gate-drive node net2, biased by the iref_snk PMOS current-source bias.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt ldo_pmos_pass_feedback_stage gnd vdd net2 vo fb
M0 vo net2 vdd vdd pmos l=l_power_p w=w_power_p*1 m=1 nf=1
R1 vo fb res r1
R2 fb gnd res r2
.ends ldo_pmos_pass_feedback_stage
subcircuits.role_hint: PMOS power pass/output stage of the LDO with integrated resistive feedback divider generating fb from the regulated output vo.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt ldo_miller_compensation_network net7 vo
R0 net1 vo res r0
C0 net7 net1 cap c0
.ends ldo_miller_compensation_network
subcircuits.role_hint: Series RC Miller compensation network between the error-amplifier high-gain node net7 and the LDO output vo for loop stability and zero placement.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt ldo_output_load_capacitor vo GND
CL vo GND cap cload
.ends ldo_output_load_capacitor
subcircuits.role_hint: Output load capacitor connected at the regulated output node vo, representing the capacitive load and output filtering element.
